title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27.1): Use the Account Payable Role Center
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces a new Accounts Payable Administrator Role Center that consolidates purchase documents, e-invoices, PDFs, and payment tasks in one interface to streamline AP workflows and reduce administrative overhead.
key_points: Centralizes all accounts payable documents and tasks in a dedicated role center
Supports management of purchase documents, e-invoices, and PDF e-documents
Integrates payment processes into a single interface
Reduces administrative time and minimizes errors through consolidated workflows

quotes.text: The Account Payable Role Center centralizes all accounts payable-related tasks, documents, and entities.
quotes.why_it_matters: It explains the core consolidation benefit that makes this role center a unified control point for AP operations

quotes.text: By consolidating these tasks, you reduce the time spent on administrative work, minimize errors, and improve productivity.
quotes.why_it_matters: It highlights the business value of the feature in concrete terms - efficiency gains, error reduction, and productivity improvements
